notes.title: Season 2 is NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Want to challenge your friends in an [b]easy cross-platform multiplayer VR game[/b]? 

Want a game which is [b]quick and easy to start[/b]? 

With [b]MAGES [/b]- the recently released Season 2 of Toe To Toe -

The new season will feature trolls, zombies, skeletons, wizards and secret spells to add some spice to the minigames set.

notes.title: Season 2
notes.content:
[b]The door to another world is open soon!
[/b]
Ah, that old witch... I should have guessed I couldn't trust her when she won the first challenge.

Against me... nobody beats me!

My pistols are also missing...  what would have been in that drink?

Yesterday I was wrangling horses and cows, today I woke up with a magic wand in my hand.

This is insane! [b]A new dimension again?[/b] The city is full of monsters, but [b]I have to use magics to beat all my challengers[/b] to increase my strength and get into the castle...it's the only way to get out of here... so come on and challenge me!

[b]Toe To Toe...[/b]

notes.title: Developer update - Ghosts and tutorials
notes.content:
First of all, we appreciate so much that more players joined us than we expected. 
Your feedback is the key to our development, so we are very grateful that you shared your experiences with us. We were lucky that they're very close to our near-term development plans :)

By hosting the game night, we wanted to support the multiplayer experience. As it's a party game, it's mainly about competition between friends and beating each other's records, but there aren't always available friends or rivals as there aren't many users worldwide yet. 

[previewyoutube=-5x9oWMaPaE;full][/previewyoutube]

As we promised, the game has been updated with a ghost option, which contains games recorded about the developers and random players' games. Now when we can not match you to another gamer we match you to one of our ghosts. It means to play against real players, just not in real-time. 

You were missing the game tutorials, that's why each game mode has been extended with a short video.

There has also been a fair demand for voice chat, which of course will be needed for multiplayer, and this is still being developed. 

Besides these main updates, We have improved the gameplay experience at a few points and fixed some bugs thanks for your reviews. 

It would be a huge help if you could join our Discord and share your suggestions to create the game as you want it to be. 

More episodes and seasons are coming soon.

notes.title: Developer Update
notes.content:
We are very grateful for all your feedback. 
Considering this, our developers are already working on Game 4. 

We felt the need to pay respect to the weapon that conquered the Wild West, and this has inspired us in the development of the new game. 

[previewyoutube=uYwdurVsyxU;full][/previewyoutube]

We received more feedback on the multiplayer weaknesses. 
As the game has just been released, there are not enough people playing it to make this option enjoyable YET, but the surprise is that you'll be able to meet the ghosts of our developers soon in-game to see and try yourself against  "professionals" (well... some of us are quite bad at our game ;-)) at any time in the absence of real opponents, as long as there aren't enough people playing to Toe To Toe at the given time.

For a true multiplayer experience, we will announce an online game night soon, when you will all be able to play against us and each other.
